paragraphs.text:
You turn around and backtrack toward the entrance to the 
ballroom. Something about the officer by the door catches your 
attention and holds it. He gives off a commanding presence and 
his eyes bore into you intensely as you make your way over to him.

As you move within earshot, he rests his hand on his baton 
and clears his throat. “I really hope there isn’t going to be any sort 
of problem, citizen. I wouldn’t want to see anyone getting hurt 
tonight.” His hand does not move from his baton.

• Make a Psychology roll: if you succeed, go to 105; if you fail, go 
to 29.
